ON THE 19 th OF JUNE, 2023  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 61791 of 2022  BETWEEN:-
 PRADEEP S/O KODU PARTE, AGED ABOUT 19 YEARS,
 R/O VILLAGE THANI, THANA AMLA, DISTRICT BETUL  (MADHYA PRADESH).
 
 (BY SHRI PRAKASH KUMAR GUPTA - ADVOCATE)

AND  1. STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION AMLA, DISTRICT BETUL (MADHYA  PRADESH).
 2. VICTIM A.
 
 (BY SHRI K.S. BAGHEL - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No. 554/2022, registered at Police Station Amla,
District Betul (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 376(3), 506 of Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel appearing for applicant has disputed the age of prosecutrix.
It is submitted that she is more than 16 years of age and having sufficient understanding.
Applicant has not committed rape on prosecutrix.
In these circumstances, applicant may be released on bail.
3 . Learned Government Advocate appearing for State opposed the application for grant of bail.

He read over statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.

sentences.text: 4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5 . In 164 statement, prosecutrix has clearly made allegations against applicant.
She is minor, aged about 14 years.
6. Considering aforesaid circumstances, bail application filed by applicant is dismissed.
7. Applicant is at liberty to file repeat application after examination of prosecutrix in Court.
